sourceFingerprintAlgorithm: sha256 over the covered paths in DECLARED ORDER; each path contributes <repo-relative path> NUL <64-hex sha256 of the file's RAW BYTES> NUL; per-file digest = script/m24/portability.ts sha256File() (node:crypto, no process spawn)

verdict.note: doc fingerprint is the committed TOOL-DOC.md; regeneration byte-identity is the drift gate.

claimTableIsDerivedFromEvidence: G5c proves it against decoy evidence directories: the generated claim row changes when a code's status changes, and a generator that hardcodes every claim as verified is rejected. Measured note: with an upstream code known-gap, a hardcoding generator reproduces the COMMITTED doc byte-for-byte, so the drift comparison alone cannot tell an honest generator from a dishonest one — which is why G5c exists rather than being folded into G1.
limitations: claim levels capped at I1 (protocol-passed) by design — I3/I4/I5 are M25 scope and declared absent
per-language fixture evidence is M25 scope; the claim table states the language-agnostic protocol claim
vocabulary lint covers docs/m24/ artifacts (tool doc + master plan); the contract and decision records are canonical and outside the lint surface
